scope: bounded official-source readiness review; no external model code execution
selection_basis: NCLR linked by pinned CorrI2P README
FreeReg acknowledged by pinned CoFiI2P README
FFreeReg recommended by pinned FreeReg README

findings.decision: not a ready pretrained calibration provider
findings.mechanism: 2D-3D neural calibration used in self-supervised point representation learning; soft image correspondence and differentiable PnP exist in model source
findings.weights: README links are todo and pretrained-weight TODO remains unchecked; no tracked checkpoint files
findings.runtime: TorchSparse/Minkowski/torch-scatter ecosystem; no inference runtime or port verified here
findings.terms: root Apache-2.0; dependencies and any future checkpoint terms still separate
findings.boundary: training dataset reads calibration and model uses calibration-derived projections; safe unknown-extrinsic inference boundary not established
findings.next: Do not mistake title/README segmentation scores for a ready calibration benchmark; require actual compatible checkpoint and independent inference path first

findings.decision: conditional distinct mechanism; not feasible in current bounded runtime
findings.mechanism: diffusion cross-modal features and ZoeDepth/FCGF geometry; PnP or 3D registration
findings.weights: README requires Stable Diffusion1.5, fine-tuned depth ControlNet, ZoeDepth and/or FCGF weights depending on feature configuration; no artifact digests obtained
findings.runtime: source includes CPU device fallbacks, so not all code is intrinsically CUDA-only; full selected pipeline CPU feasibility unverified, missing dependencies/weights, 1.3GB free disk
findings.terms: no tracked root LICENSE/COPYING; bundled dependencies and checkpoint terms require separate review, no redistribution assumed
findings.boundary: virtual depth-camera pose must be explicit and have overlap; demo uses identity and loads evaluation-only GT separately; cannot pass unknown KITTI calibration as initializer
findings.next: Do not install/download a multi-model environment without a usable resource/weight plan; no adapter before prerequisites

findings.decision: simpler registration mechanism; not a CPU/weight-free fallback
findings.mechanism: DepthPro reconstructed surface, YOHO/FCGF descriptors, scale adjustment and mixed Kabsch/reprojection registration; no virtual LiDAR camera
findings.weights: README requires DepthPro plus YOHO backbone and PartI weights; links only, no bytes or hashes acquired
findings.runtime: demo explicitly selects cuda for DepthPro and YOHO, FCGF imports MinkowskiEngine; changing a device string is not a validated port
findings.terms: no tracked root LICENSE/COPYING; DepthPro subdirectory has Apple terms that do not automatically license whole repository or checkpoints
findings.boundary: demo estimates intrinsics, rescales image-derived 3D and uses random sampling; calibration comparison needs frozen known-intrinsics/scale/seed policy and original point lineage
findings.next: No descriptor swap using rejected stereo surfaces and calling it Free-FreeReg; obtain model prerequisites before pilot

decision: No newly reviewed provider is ready for inference in the current runtime. Close this bounded search; prioritize execution resources and pinned model artifacts.
data_scope: source checkouts include bundled demo assets, none used for evaluation; no new KITTI archive or holdout fetched
